name: Saxagliptin Hydrochloride

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Diabetic Ketoacidosis in Patients with Type 1 Diabetes Mellitus and Other Ketoacidosis : Consider ketone monitoring in patients at risk for ketoacidosis, as indicated. Assess for ketoacidosis regardless of presenting blood glucose levels and discontinue dapagliflozin and saxagliptin if…

summary: According to the drug label, a warning involves diabetic ketoacidosis, a condition where harmful acids called ketones build up in the body [3]. The label notes that patients at risk should consider monitoring ketones, and the medicine should be stopped if this condition occurs [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a low score for liver and heart risks [M].
